# Talkpal

> Talkpal is an AI-powered language learning platform offering conversation practice in 84+ languages with real-time feedback and personalized tutoring.

Talkpal provides both consumer and enterprise solutions for language learning, supporting learners through interactive conversation practice, speech recognition, and AI-driven personalized feedback. The platform serves individual learners, educational institutions, and businesses seeking to improve team language proficiency.

## Key Topics

- AI language tutor
- Multilingual learning
- Conversation practice
- Speech recognition
- Real-time feedback
- Pronunciation feedback
- Personalized learning
- Mobile app
- Language learning platform
- 84+ languages supported
- Free trial
- Enterprise solutions
- Educational platform
- AI-powered tutoring
- Interactive language practice

## Core Platform

- [AI Language Teacher - Talkpal](https://talkpal.ai): Talkpal homepage: AI-powered language learning app supporting 84+ languages
- [Learning - Talkpal](https://talkpal.ai/languages): Language selection and learning platform for multi-language conversation practice

## Solutions & Products

- [Talkpal for Business - Talkpal](https://talkpal.ai/talkpal-for-business): Enterprise solution for team language skills and professional communication
- [Talkpal for Education - Talkpal](https://talkpal.ai/talkpal-for-education): Educational platform with AI tutoring tools for students and institutions
